messages:
Jordan Lee: Hey all, quick onboarding snag. Clicking the Okta 'Sign in with Google' from the welcome email immediately bounces me to an 'account mismatch' page. I think Chrome is auto-selecting my personal account. Also 1Password shows no seat yet. Any quick fixes so I can access Drive and docs?

Sasha (IT): Welcome Jordan! Common issue. Two fast attempts: 1) open an incognito window and paste the Okta link, 2) sign out of all Google accounts and try again. If neither works I can re-issue the invite to a +work alias or enable explicit account chooser on our side. Do you have a security key yet or just phone MFA?

Jordan Lee: I only have phone MFA right now. I tried incognito but it immediately redirected to the mismatch page. My company email is jordan.lee@redwood.com but I do have jordan.lee@gmail.com that probably gets selected.

Sasha (IT): OK. I'll reprovision to jordan.lee+redwood@gmail.com to avoid the auto-selection. Also I'm going to create a temporary Drive share so you can access onboarding docs while SSO resolves.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #4399 created -> IT:okta assigned to Sasha (ETA ~2 hours).

Ben (People Ops): Jordan, I've approved your 1Password seat request (ticket #4401). Sasha, could you confirm group membership so the seat syncs? Asha, can you confirm manager sign-off for access?

Asha (Manager): Confirmed. Welcome Jordan! I've asked Ops to give you view access to the "eng-onboarding" folder. Ping me if anything else blocks ramp-up. :wave:

Sasha (IT): Done: reprovisioned invite to jordan.lee+redwood@gmail.com. Also added you to a provisional Drive folder (view). 1Password seat is queued; group sync sometimes takes 5-10 minutes. We'll ship a YubiKey to the on-file address; use phone MFA in the meantime.

Jordan Lee: I can see the Drive folder now and the 1Password invite arrived. Thanks! Quick follow-up  where's the doc for adding a YubiKey or setting passkeys later?

Sasha (IT): Docs are under handbook -> IT onboarding. Quick steps: in Okta dashboard go to Security Methods -> Add new -> Security Key, then follow the browser prompt. If you use Chrome on macOS, you may be asked to allow the browser to access the USB device or Touch ID. DM me if it fails and I can walk through it.

Jordan Lee: Great, that solves it. Appreciate everyone's help.
